units.source_text: 听说南禅寺附近有所合适的房子出售，太吉郎想趁秋高气爽散步之便出去看看。

en.t: Hearing that a suitable house was for sale near Nanzenji, Takichiro thought he would go out and have a look while taking a walk in the clear autumn weather.

units.source_text: 于是，带了妻子和女儿同去。

en.t: So he took his wife and daughter along with him.
